title: Print job is calibrated and meets its output profile
description: A print job for home printing or a 1:1 plotter carries a calibration control square (D2P-SEM-091), named media match their ISO 216 dimensions (D2P-SEM-092), and a home-print job meets the binding page properties of its output profile: the profile media, tiling with a positive overlap, registration marks, sheet labels and a label per piece instance (D2P-SEM-095).
